caption:
Six touches. Each one moves the lead closer to a signed job.

Most owners send one text, hear nothing back, and move on. The lead didn't die. The follow-up did.

Here's the cadence:
Touch 1: instant text, under 60 seconds
Touch 2: live call within the hour
Touch 3: next day, answer the objection they haven't said out loud
Touch 4: day 3, direct yes/no nudge on the quote
Touch 5-6: days 5 to 10, one more value touch, then a clean close

Run this cadence by hand on your next ten leads.

Then picture it firing on every lead without you touching a phone.
